attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page says plainly that she is unknown to the synaxaria and that everything it has comes from one manuscript: «Για την Αγία αυτή γίνεται λόγος στον Παρισινό Κώδικα 259 φ. 2α, όπου υπάρχει και Στιχηρό τροπάριο της». That is a thin source but not the site's own refusal to vouch for the entry: the page carries no asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου», which the 1 Νοεμβρίου entry for Cyprian and Juliana does carry and for which that entry is refused. **`martyr` is the page's own guess and is recorded as such**: «κατά πάσα πιθανότητα πέθανε μαρτυρικά», in all probability she died a martyr. The στιχηρό of the Paris codex is a sticheron and not a troparion or a kontakion, and its text is not printed, so no hymn is drafted. No year, so no `dates` object.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (1 October 2026).
